errors.quote: As $s/W\le m^\sigma,$ $\sigma<1,$ internal levels sum geometrically
errors.problem: σ<1 is not the condition that makes the internal levels decay. The paper first bounds the node overhead O((eK)^τ+1) by O(e^λ), using K≤e^{c/β} and τ(1+c/β)<λ. The series then has ratio a/m^λ<1 because a≤m^σ<m^λ. With the overhead (eK)^τ as written on the page, the ratio would be a/m^τ, and this is not below 1 under the paper's choice τ=σ.

The layer costs O(Vd^{λ'}), where d is the maximum number of axes, not D. It beats separate passes only when D is close to d (D>d^{λ'}). The saving is relative to the d≥D passes of the worst case, as in the paper's comparison with D≤d separate factors.
